grants.name: Redland City Council Community Support Grant
grants.status: Open - Round 2 closes midnight end of 1 November 2026 AEST
grants.best_for: Up to $20,000 for Redland City community projects with social, cultural, recreational or environmental outcomes. Requires not-for-profit eligibility, Redland location, insurance, quotes and reporting capacity.
grants.deadline: Round 2 closes midnight (end of day) 1 November 2026 AEST, equivalent to 14:00 UTC on 1 November. Confirm submission in the official SmartyGrants portal before closure.
grants.applicants: Incorporated not-for-profits or Act entities; unincorporated groups through an eligible auspice; registered wildlife carers are a conservation-only exception

grants.name: Creative Australia Four Year Investment for Organisations 2029–32
grants.best_for: Mature small-to-medium arts and cultural organisations with a strong artistic record and credible four-year vision. A project repo, informal network or proposed festival is not itself an eligible organisation.
grants.funding: $100,000–$550,000 per year for four years, subject to pre-application confirmation and final application assessment
grants.deadline: Pre-applications close 3:00pm AEDT 27 October 2026; confirmed applicants submit final applications by 3:00pm AEST 6 April 2027
grants.applicants: Legally constituted Australian small-to-medium arts and cultural organisations; trusts are ineligible and artistic achievement, governance and multi-year readiness must be evidenced.

grants.name: ARENA Launchpad Program - Startup Funding Round 2026
grants.best_for: Promising founders and early-stage startups developing pre-commercial renewable-energy or enabling technologies aligned with ARENA's mandate. A community idea or local information site is not eligible without an actual startup, eligible technology and commercialisation pathway.
grants.funding: $500,000 per grant, with up to a further $500,000 for projects with high capital-expenditure requirements; $15 million is the round envelope
grants.applicants: Eligible founders and early-stage startups with technology aligned to ARENA's mandate, subject to the program guidelines, round announcement, applicant structure, readiness and commercialisation requirements.

grants.name: Screen Australia First Nations Feature Development - October 2026
grants.best_for: Feature screenplay development led by eligible experienced Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander writers and directors, with First Nations authorship, rights and decision-making kept central.
grants.funding: Up to $30,000, or up to $45,000 if a producer is attached, other than in exceptional circumstances.
grants.deadline: Next deadline is 5:00pm AEDT Thursday 22 October 2026 (4:00pm AEST in Brisbane). Later published deadlines follow in January, March and May 2027.
grants.applicants: Eligible Australian Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander producers, writers or writer-directors meeting the program credit, team, rights and Screen Australia Terms of Trade requirements. Identity, experience, authority and eligibility must be supplied by the applicant and cannot be inferred.

grants.name: Screen Australia First Nations TV Drama Development - October 2026
grants.best_for: Further development of First Nations-led television drama treatments, scripts, series bibles, research and financing pathways with experienced Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander key creatives.
grants.funding: One-offs up to $30,000, or up to $45,000 with a producer attached; series up to $65,000, other than in exceptional circumstances.
grants.deadline: Next deadline is 5:00pm AEDT Thursday 22 October 2026 (4:00pm AEST in Brisbane). Later published deadlines follow in January, March and May 2027.
grants.applicants: Eligible Australian Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander producers, writers or writer-directors meeting the program credit, team, rights and Screen Australia Terms of Trade requirements. Identity, experience, authority and eligibility must be supplied by the applicant and cannot be inferred.

grants.name: Creative Australia Contemporary Music Touring Program - October 2026
grants.best_for: A defined Australian tour of original contemporary music with at least three venues or locations outside the performer's hometown. It can support performers, managers, agents or music networks, but it does not fund a general music platform, a single local event or untested ecosystem proposal.
grants.funding: $5,000-$50,000 depending on the eligible tour route; metropolitan-only tours may request up to $15,000, tours with at least one regional or remote performance up to $25,000, and qualifying remote tours up to $50,000
grants.deadline: Applications close 3:00pm AEDT Tuesday 13 October 2026. Future published closing dates are 2 March and 8 June 2027.
grants.applicants: Eligible Australian individuals, groups or organisations applying for one tour of original Australian contemporary music; performers, managers, agents and music networks may apply on behalf of industry professionals, subject to Creative Australia eligibility and acquittal requirements.
